description: Walpitagamage Dharmadasa v. Manawaduge Ebert Walpitagamage Dharmadasa v. Manawaduge Ebert View More before Hon. Upaly Abeyrathne, J.
parties: Walpitagamage Dharmadasa v. Manawaduge Ebert Walpitagamage Dharmadasa v. Manawaduge Ebert View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the District Court order declaring title in favour of the Respondent, contending that the transfer deed was executed only as security for a loan and gave rise to a constructive trust under Section 83 of the Trusts Ordinance. Held - the agreed period for re-transfer had expired without payment, after which Respondent became absolute owner. Appeal dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
